notes.title: 0.1.1. PATCH NOTES - AUGUST 4, 2021
notes.content:
[b][h2]GAMEPLAY UPDATES[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Added a Difficulty Menu with 3 selectable difficulties and a Custom Difficulty option that allows you to tinker with every setting of the round.

[i]Easy:[/i] 0,5x AI Speed, no moving customers (3), no AI abilities, 5 Power Ups
[i]Normal:[/i] 0,75x AI Speed, moving customers (4), no AI abilities, 5 Power Ups
[i]Hard:[/i] 1x AI Speed, moving customers (5), AI abilities, 3 Power Ups

[*] Added different Leaderboards to each difficulty.

[*] Added the ability to place a Tracker on one customer. Doing this takes up one hand slot, but selecting it allows you to see an indicator in the direction of your Tracker through walls. (Right click on a customer to place it, and right click anywhere else to disable it)

[*] Added a Magazine that contains all products with their names and pictures. This way you can familiarize yourself with any listed product’s appearance while the game is paused. The categorized pages even give a hint where you might find the item you are looking for. (Open with M)

[*] The Shop-O-Tron AI can now use some of the Power Ups and its Ultimate Ability as well to transfer your inventory. Tip: You can prevent some of them by using the Firewall Power Up!

[*] Shortened the baking and slicing times to make your efforts worth it.
[/list]

[b][h2]VISUAL UPDATES[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Added a popup effect to notify the opponent’s used Power Ups that have an effect on you, or when an ability is blocked by a Firewall.

[*] Added the List Download icon to the customer’s tablet to make it more clear why it’s not showing up.

[*] Changed the Ultimate’s cooldown colour to orange, and made its icon faded until it’s loaded to make it more distinguishable and encourage its use.
[/list]

[b][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the player from shooting a product to a customer when they were too close.

[*] Fixed a bug that selected the wrong products in the Baking Oven’s menu.

[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Grapple Upgrade Power Up to grab a surface.

[*] The animations now match the speed of the characters.
[/list]
